Olen Fay King Jr. (May 8, 1944 – August 21, 2021) was a member of the staff at a home for troubled boys in Longstreet, Louisiana. He was also a member of the staff at New Bethany Baptist Church Home for Boys in Walterboro, South Carolina. King was arrested after the New Bethany boy's home was raided by police and signs of neglect and abuse were found in the home. King faced charges including kidnapping and unlawful neglect. An estimated sixty boys were living at the New Bethany boy's home at the time.
